nom: Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Facial Cleanser

avis.texte: This is a great gentle, nourishing, budget-friendly facial cleanser. I have been using it for a few months now, and my somewhat sensitive skin is very happy with it— no irritation or breakouts! It doesn't foam up like most cleansers, so it is not stripping or drying. It gently washes away makeup, sunscreen, and dirt. This is a great simple base to a well-rounded skincare routine, and I would recommend it!

avis.titre: Gentle Enough for My Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: This cleanser is so soothing! No stripping, no tightness, just clean skin that feels calm right after washing. The oat formula is gentle but still removes makeup and daily grime well. My redness has even calmed down. Perfect for sensitive skin days!
I really like this face wash. It is really gentle on skin. I love that there's no fragrance. It never irritates my skin. This seems to really help with repairing moisture barrier problems!

This is such a nice gentle cleanser with no smell at all. It has been really nice for my sensitive skin (it's not at all drying). I definitely recommend it to those looking for something gentle, yet still effective.
If you have sensitive skin this is a really good product. Is a fragrance free and oat cleanser. Also have a good price. This is my second time buying and I love that ! Highly recommended

avis.titre: Aveeno Calm And Restore Oat Cleanser
avis.texte: This is the perfect facial cleanser for those with sensitive skin! It keeps my skin calm while still cleansing and moisturizing. It removes all my makeup and impurities with just one rinse. It lathers well and you only need a small amount, so it lasts a long time. I appreciate that its fragrance free cause sometimes strong scents can irritate my skin more.

avis.titre: Something important about this cleanser is that it
avis.texte: I love this cleanser from Aveeno It leave the skin super soft cleanses without drying without drying it out and is perfect for sensitive skin because it is fragrance free

This product is a terrible cleanser. It does not remove any amount of makeup, product, or oil from my face. A manual makeup removal tool (like a scrub brush, or microfiber towel) must be used to clean the skin. Some positives: it has little to no smell and does not seem to irritate my skin at all. The pump works well and does not get clogged with product. It is very gentle (but does not do the job it claims to do!)

I use this product daily. Before I found this product, it had been a long time since I had used a cleanser consistently due to struggling to find one I enjoyed using. I love this cleanser. It is gentle on my sensitive skin but makes my skin feel clean, and keeps oil at bay. I follow with moisturiser in the morning and night and I am very happy with this product. I think it is great value for money.

Almost too moisturizing for me. I feel like it doesn't give as deep a clean as I would like for an everyday cleaner. Perhaps best for VERY dry skin. The container comes with a lot in it which is nice.

I was looking for a gentle and clean facial cleanser and this hit all the marks. It helps me remove my makeup and makes my face feel smooth and clean with its soothing formula. Would absolutely recommend!
I loveeeeee this stuff !! It works amazing on my skin. This just reminded me i need more!! I wish the bottle was bigger but it's worth every drop! Very nice texture.
Love how lightweight this cleanser was. No strong fragrance so felt super healthy on my skin. Definitely perfect for people who have gentle and sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Use for dry skin to leave clean and moisturized.
avis.texte: Really gentle foam, almost no foam, and doesn't irritate my skin. Not drying, but leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped or tight. Part of my nightly routine. I found it doesn't remove mascara or makeup well but it worked fine for the daily grime. I use in the winter when my face is really dry. Used every last drop and this bottle lasted quite a while so it was a good deal.

avis.titre: It has become indispensable in my daily routine
avis.texte: It has necome indispensable in my daily routine; I use it morming and night applying it to my damo face with a gentle massage. Its milky consistency is incredibly comforting and, although it does not generare foam due to its moisturizing formula, its effectiveness in cleanning is total without damaging the skim barrier. It has helped noticeably with dryness eliminating that feeling of tigtness and i have noticed my pores much cleaner and more refined in addition, it has excellent durability, sinse its texture spreads a lot, keeping my skin calm and radiant with very little product.

I wanted to love this cleanser so much, but it did not work for me. I have eczema on my face, and any time I used it, the cleanser would cause a fierce burning sensation around my eyes and any skin that was remotely irritated. Odds are that there's an ingredient or two in it that my skin isn't friendly with. On skin that wasn't already sensitized, the cleanser was moisturizing and was effective at cleansing my skin without stripping it. It does not foam at all, so if a foaming sensorial experience is important to you, this probably won't be a cleanser you enjoy.

I'm not sure if I just got a bad batch? This came out soo thing and didn't foam up at all. It also stunk of rubbing alcohol and immediately started stinging my eyes without it even being near my eyes. It's surprising because I have the version of their facial serum and I LOVE IT. Not sure what happened here.

avis.titre: Gentle, soothing cleanser that cleans without stri
avis.texte: I really enjoy this cleanser, especially for sensitive skin. It has a very gentle, creamy texture that doesn't foam much but still leaves my skin feeling clean without stripping it.

avis.titre: It is very good , effective for everyday use for s
avis.texte: I really like this cleanser. It is very gentle on the skin and doesn't make my fcae dry after using it. My skin feels soft, clean , calm. It is perfect for everday use and for sensitive skin.I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for mild and effective face cleanser.

avis.titre: Great facial wash for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love using this cleanser when I'm breaking out and my skin needs a little extra care. It is very gentle on the skin which is great. This is perfect if you have sensitive skin. It is mild but cleans very well
This facial cleanser is fragrance-free and leaves my skin clean and fresh. My skin absorbs it well. Very easy to Apply. The consistency is soft.

Love this cleanser. I will always come back to it. It's so hydrating and feels like your skin is actually clean, unlike some other hydrating cleansers. this is the only hydrating cleaner that hasn't broken my acne prone skin out.
Aveeno calm + restore cleanser works very well for sensitive skin.Easy to open and pump leaves no residue or breakouts.Leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed.

Aveeno calm restore ost cleanser is great for my sensitive skin. This cleanser gives me good texture and freshness to my skin. It helps me to clean my pores and worth to try this product for sensitive skin.
Used this cleanser before.Very good for sensitive skin.It is calming and refreshing. Scent free .Not very good for make up removal though. It is thick but easy to take off.

avis.titre: Calm skin, no breakouts, and the gentlest cleanse
avis.texte: I've been loving Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser! The creamy, non-foaming texture feels super gentle and doesn't strip my skin. It rinses easily without needing a lot of product (great volume per use), and leaves my face feeling soft, hydrated, and calm.It's gentle enough to use around my eyes without irritation or stinging. Since using it, I've noticed less redness and no new breakouts, which is a big plus for my sensitive skin. I also appreciate that it's fragrance-free, hypoallergenic, and non-comedogenic.

This product did absolutely nothing except leave a residue on my face after using it. The first bottle I bought had a faulty pump so I exchanged it, only for the second pump to not work either. Despite that, I really tried to get it to work for me, only to have horrible breakouts. I never felt like my face was actually clean.
It has the texture of a water cream. I havent had any breakouts using this. It doesnt foam so good for sensitive skin. No redness. No irritation. Unscented so perfect for sensitive skin.

What I like most about this cleanser is how calming it feels while washing my face. The texture is creamy and comforting, and it doesn't foam aggressively, which makes it ideal for days when my skin feels dry or irritated. After cleansing, my skin feels balanced and soft rather than squeaky clean. It's not meant for deep makeup removal, but as a gentle everyday cleanser, it does its job well. I'd especially recommend this to people who prefer simple, soothing skincare without harsh ingredients.

I love this skin cleanser, it's definitely a go to for me especially in the colder months when my skin gets dry and sensitive. It's very calming and nourishing, non stripping, and hydrating to my skin!

This is a nice and calming cleanser that provides nourishing qualities especially won't the oats. It feels soft and moisturizing. Gently clarifies the skin. It's also easy to rinse and there no residue.

avis.titre: A creamy emulsion cleanser that absorbs well and s
avis.texte: I have been using the Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser and it is great for sensitive skin. It has a smooth, creamy emulsion that spreads easily and rinses off well without residue. It absorbs quickly once rinsed, leaving the skin clean, calm, and hydrated without a greasy feel. It cleans gently, does not dry out the skin, and a small amount lasts a long time with no irritation.

avis.titre: Perfect face wash  for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Have used it for over a week and I cannot recommend it enough. There is a slight scent but nothing too overbearing or irritating. I have sensitive skin and this has not made me irritated
Love all aveeno products and this one did not disappoint. The small details do matter and I prefer this packaging over the original. It leaves your skin feeling softer after one wash.
Honestlu its a good cleander for calming and soothing the skin. But when i used it didnt feel like it was cleansing my skin. Very good gor senditive skin though
My teenager loves this cleanser; besides achieving excellent deep-cleaning results, its fragrance and the texture it leaves on the face are so valuable that they keep using it.

avis.titre: Leaves skin smooth soft and hydrated
avis.texte: It has cleaning abilities that leaves skin to be clean, hydrated soft and smooth that doesnt dry your skin out. It makes the skin feel refreshed after removing heavy makeup that helps skin to not breakout or turn red depending on the concerns

I've been using this face wash for years now and never had an issue till the last bottle I purchased. It's given me red irritated spots on my eye lids and burns my skin. I hate to have to find a new product now but I cant take the chance of it damaging my skin now
Great product smells great a little bit more pricey than the leading brand. Very few ingredients goes on very smooth. Does not leave greasy residue.. great product

I was so happy to try the Aveeno Calm + Restore Gentle Nourishing Oat Face Cleanser. Now that the colder months are approaching my face is already starting to dry out. Many similiar products tend to strip my skin and make it tight. It's very bothersome to me especially since I wash my face twice a day. I was very impressed with this cleanser. It was very gentle, lightly scented, and overall felt like velvet on my skin. It didn't make my face feel tight and uncomfortable and effectively removed any makeup I had on. I love that it has oat added in since it acts as calming agent for the skin and didn't mess with my skins moisture barrier. This cleanser is a must especially for the winter months and will keep skin from getting reactive!

avis.titre: Wow.  Finally the perfect morning cleanser
avis.texte: OMG. This is the best face cleaner I have ever purchased. I use it every morning. I cannot adequately convey how perfect this creamy oat cleanser is for soothing my skin and maintaining moisture. I have tried dozens of facial cleansers and by far, this is my favorite morning cleanser (I use different products to double cleanse at night).

Did not leave my skin tight feeling and did not strip my skin. Could feel that this lacks a bit of cleansing power but for me, it is fine. This is hydrating and soothing but if you have already found the cleanser that you like, I would not recommend to go out of your way to buy this product. The more must-try products are the moisturiser and serum. This cleanser is certainly not bad but it is not exceptionally good either, though it is a good cleanser overall especially for infl amed or for a damaged skin barrier. This is a second cleanser that does not remove makeup and sunscreen. However, for me, in my experience with this cleanser, this product is great and fantastic!

This cleanser is very gentle and great for dry skin. It doesn't strip my skin or leaving it feel tight. It doesn't foam up and remains gel like. Sometimes it's not enough to remove sunscreen, so a double cleanse may be needed.
Love this cleanser so much. So good for my sensitive skin.I've the smell it's not over powering scent. The packaging shows that it's for sensitive skin 100% recommend

I used this as a cleanser for sensitive skin. I developed what I thought was an eye infection. Extremely itchy eyes, red swollen beyond words. After 3 eye exams and a few different prescribed eye drops treatments I started eliminating skin products. The third ophthalmologist told me my eyes were having an allergic reaction. After doing research I saw that this product contains feverfew and because it is in the ragweed family it can cause allergic reactions. I tossed it and the start of my use of the product coincided with my eye irritation. After a few days my eyes recovered

avis.titre: Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser gent
avis.texte: The Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser is wonderfully gentle and soothing, making it perfect for sensitive skin. It cleanses without stripping or irritating, and leaves my face feeling soft, calm, and hydrated. I love the lightweight, creamy texture, though it doesn't remove heavy makeup as effectively, so I use it more as a daily cleanser than a full makeup remover. Overall, it's a reliable, calming option that keeps skin balanced and comfortable.
This cleanser is ok. It doesn't foam like my usual cleanser but I wanted to try a different brand. It would be useful for someone who has sensitive skin.

Aveeno usually has amazing products that work well for my skin, but this cleanser was never a hit for me. I've always found it very irritating and have had many breakouts due to using it. Very good value for the price and overall it is very good at moisturizing due to its gel-like texture and scent-free formula! I wouldn't recommend it.

avis.titre: "Mild scent, simple packaging, creamy texture, soo
avis.texte: "Mild scent, simple packaging, creamy texture, soothing oat ingredients, effective cleansing calms,and nourishes sensitive skin daily."

avis.titre: So gentle on skin, yet cleanses thoroughly!
avis.texte: As someone who suffers with acne and sensitive skin, this cleanser has been a life changer! It is made with pure ingredients that will not irritate your skin, does not foam up and has no fragrance- yet my skin feels so soft and clean!! This is a god send!! Couldn't live without it now!!
This product is so effective and the texture works beautifully on my skin! The texture feels silky and the scent is not strong at all! I've always loved aveenos ingredients and packaging!
This cleanser is really great especially if you have dry sensitive skin. The oat calms irritation, and this cleanser doesn't foam. It's very gentle but still cleanses well.

I bought the Aveeno Oat Cleanser hoping it would be a gentle daily cleanser, but unfortunately, it didn't work for my skin. After a few days of use, I started noticing small breakouts all over my face. It didn't feel harsh or drying, but it just didn't agree with my skin at all. I really wanted to love it because the texture felt nice and it's marketed as calming, but it actually made things worse for me. If you're acne-prone, I'd recommend patch testing first.

avis.titre: Proper face wash for daily use
avis.texte: Good ingredients, pleasure to use, because of the texture of the product. No wow effect, just proper face wash for daily use. I was expecting more from that product

This is a simple, yet effective cleanser, which does not strip my skin, nor leave it feeling dry. The oat base is nourishing and soothing, leaving my skin feeling calm. Great for anyone with sensitive or dry skin.

This cleanser is very very gentle, a little too gentle, where it makes you question if it's actually cleaning your face or not. I'm pretty sure it made me breakout in whiteheads because it wasn't removing my sunscreen effectively. This cleanser might be better for only AM use, when you need a lighter cleanse, this definitely would not take your makeup off.
I love this the ingredients are great for my skin the texture is amazing there not really a Scent wish I like the packaging of the bottle is a great size
This is a very nice cleanser, but I just wish it was a bit more moisturizing, It is very lightweight and soft on your skin

avis.titre: I do not recommend buying products online
avis.texte: Sadly, I feel like product quality cleanliness has gone down the drain. I bought this online since I noticed many products in store looked dirty. Sadly, I was not expecting to receive my product dirty. Overall, product is great just can't use.

I bought this cleanser because I have been experiencing dry, flakey skin after using my current cleanser. Unfortunately, the pump is defective and will not dispense any of the cleanser out, after several — and I mean several — pumps. So I had to unscrew the pump to use it. Thankfully, I did not notice any dry flakes after using this to wash my face once. I just wish that the applicator actually worked. I'm wondering if this is in part due to the fact that the texture of this cleanser is quite thick.

avis.titre: it's obe of the best face cleaning products
avis.texte: This product is amazing. Hydrated your skin and cleaned deeply. After using my skin, it is so glow and smuut, so nice. I use it twice per day. Is nice packaging and easy to use as a pump.

We love Aveeno in our house as we have lots of sensitive skin. This has been a fab addition for both my husband and my pre teen daughter. She needs to wash her face more but hates anything that lathers. This is the perfect gently cleanser for her to use that doesn't aggravate her sensitive skin. It smells divine and does a great job cleaning skin. I use it for taking make up off and it's gentle but effective. The handy pump packaging means you get just the right amount and limits waste.
This is my go to water based cleanser as I have very sensitive skin! Doesn't foam and strip oils from my face. Nice pump packaging. One pump is enough and lasts ages. Unscented which is amazing

I've been using the Aveeno Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser, and it's perfect for my sensitive skin. It has a lightweight, gel like texture that cleanses without stripping or leaving my skin tight. It feels soothing and works great in my morning routine or as a second cleanse. Highly recommend for anyone with sensitive or easily irritated skin!
Safe to say I've found my new go to cleanser. The aveeno oat range is perfect for dry sensitive skin. This oat cleanser leaves my face feeling soft and clean.

I could happily say that I've found something that suits my dry/sensitive skin. This cleanser is pretty good since it doesn't leave any dry patches on my skin. I have tried various cleansers in the past which claimed to have worked out for dry skin but some just similar to the regular face wash. My skin felt very tight and dry after the wash and some had too much moisture that it never felt like the cleaner did its job. This cleanser is a perfect balance with moisture and cleaning properties and my skin actually feels very normal after the wash. Though I would not recommend washing your face with Lukewarm or warm water along with this cleaner as it strips off the natural moisture from the face and the skin ends up being super dry. I usually use a cleansing balm followed by this cleanser in my routine and this combination works the best for my skin type. So dry skin girlies, get your hands on this one because this one is a keeper.
Great as a second cleanse, or morning cleanse. Needs afacecloth to remove product well, doesnt leave skin tight or eyes stinging. Doesnt remove make up very well

As a person who has extremely reactionary, dry, acne prone skin, this cleanser saved my skin! No rashes or burning! I dont wear a lot of foundation (due to my reactions to most products) but I can attest that it takes off eye makeup and non-waterproof makeup with ease. This is not a product that lathers if that is something you look out for!non
This is like having a spa day at home! Perfect cleanser for sensitive skin, fragrance free but leaves your face feeling clean and refreshed this helps hydrate your skin, easy to use bottle
Leaves my face looking super nice and glowy and plump but then dries out my face worse then before
I wanted to love this :( ive been using this product for about three weeks and ive noticed so so so many blackheads on my nose
This is a really nice, gentle but effective cleanser. It's good for younger kids too but also worked for me as an adult. I highly recommend if you have sensitive skin or an impaired barrier!

This is a great cleanser for the summertime. It can be drying if you use it too much so I tend to stick to using it only in the summer and then switch to something else in the winter when my face tends to be a bit dryer. It is gentle and good for people with sensitive skin recommended

This product is PERFECT for those with sensitive skin. this is the only cleanser I've tried that hasn't made my face all red. The product goes on beautifully without leaving a greasy residue and always leaves my skin looking bright and beautiful!

avis.titre: Great for dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is very sensitive and if something isnt good for my face , i can tell very soon after using it because normally i will brake out. This is very soft and gentle on my face and i love that it didnt dry me out as well. I would recommend this item.

Aveeno, why, why, WHY did you discontinue your Absolutely Ageless gel cleanser?? WHY???? NO other facial cleanser, whether high OR low-end, made my skin "squeaky" clean the way Absolutely Ageless did!!! I just don't get it! This did NOTHING for my skin, and it certainly didn't make me feel like my face was thoroughly cleansed. I'm very disappointed with Aveeno for discontinuing what USED to be the best cleanser on the market.

This soap is great, as long as you're not wearing makeup. On a fresh face it is leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed without drying out your skin. It is gentle and leaves your skin nice and soft. Unfortunately, it does not remove makeup well. So you will need to eaiter wash more than once or use something else before/after using this soap to make sure all makeup is removed.

This is the gentlest cleaner I have ever used. It so easy on the skin and cleans really well without damaging the skin. It absolutely has no sulphates or any other harmful chemicals. Leaves the skin moist , doesn't dry the skin. Skin feels really moisturized and smooth after the use
The Aveeno Cleanser is super gentle on the face. It is easy to apply and easy to wash off and doesn't leave a stinging sensation on the skin. It is fragrance free and great for sensitive skin.

Aveeno Calm + Restore Gentle Nourishing Oat Face Cleanser is very gentle on my skin. I like that a little goes a long way. I use one pump and rub it between my hands and then apply it to my face. It doesn't have any harsh or overpowering smells and doesn't irritate my skin. The consistency starts out thicker but quickly becomes thinner once applied, making it easy to rinse off my face. Sometimes cleansers can be so thick that it takes extra work just to rinse them off, but this oat cleanser isn't like that. Overall, I think this is a great cleanser as well as a good option for those with more sensitive skin or sensory difficulties with fragrances.

I have to be honest, at first, I was not sure I was going to like this cleanser. I actually didn't like it at first because it doesn't lather and I'm used to cleansers lathering quite a bit. This one doesn't lather at all, yet it does leave my skin feeling clean. I've found that on days when I felt like my skin got extra oily, using 2 pumps of the cleanser was better, while days when my skin didn't get oily or dirty, one pump was enough. It's definitely gentle on my skin and doesn't leave it feeling like it's stripped of moisture.

This cleanser is gentle and perfect for sensitive skin. It removes dirt, oil and makeup thoroughly without any harsh irritating ingredients. This formula is very low foam and rinse clean leaving no residue. Its in a convenient pump bottle that dispenses the perfect amount every time and is mess free.
I love this cleanser from aveeno, it is gentle and mild for my skin. It helps my dry skin hydrated and nourishes. I highly recommend this skincare regimen to my friends and family.

This cleanser is okay. If you are in a budget than you will like this. I used it morning and night. I think overall it's a great product if you don't have a lot of money to spend on skin care products.

I don't have any sensitive skin but I've heard good things about users with sensitive skin having good results from using this. As for me, it was just an okay cleanser. It doesn't clean your make up well as it's a gentle cleanser. I will continue using this as my morning routine cleanser because a gentle cleanser with clean ingredients is much needed!

I personally love eveeno skincare products and this was basic. It's perfect for those with sensitive skin or skin that reacts to products or become aggravated easily. This didn't feel like it cleansed my skin if I'm being 100%

This Aveeno cleanser has been amazing for my skin! It's gentle and soothing, leaves my skin feeling clean but never tight or dry. I have sensitive skin, and this cleanser keeps it calm, reduces any redness or irritation. It lathers nicely, rinses easily, and doesn't strip my skin. Love it!
This product is amazing. It has helped my dry skin tremendously. I highly recommend this product to anyone that has dry skin on their face. It leaves it so soft and smooth.

This Aveeno Calm + Restore nourishing oat cleanser is very gentle and great for sensitive skin. There's no fragrance or active ingredients which is great. I overall liked using this product and felt it made my skin softer and was quite soothing but I just wish it had a bit more lather- it's basically like washing your face with a serum. I do like that it doesn't leave my skin feeling tight or 'squeaky' clean.
I absolutely love this product ! I would definitely recommend this product to everyone I know . It works perfectly and will be added to my routine .

This cleanser worked so well with my sensitive dry skin! And really moisturized I didn't feel dry at all after using this product and no skin reactions which is a huge plus. Yes I would recommend this product to anyone who has a similar skin type to mine.
I love the Aveeno Calm+Restore Cleanser! It's very gentle on the face. It does a great job breaking up your makeup. After washing your face is not left feeling dry and stiff.

I am using this cleanser as my second cleanser during my skin care routine. I wish it would clean my skin a little bit better but it still does an ok job. I do not have sensitive skin and my skin did not get irritated when I used this cleanser. I like that it is fragrance free and not drying.
This product had a good texture and good smell. It did an ok job moisturizing my skin.

I really do love Aveeno oat calm and restore facial gentle cleanser. I've been using it for a few weeks and my face is soft and feels hydrated. It didn't irritate my skin. It doesn't lather so there's no residue. My skin feels and looks more radiant and softer. I can see the gentle care Aveeno has put in towards caring for sensitive skin. There's no scent and is clear enough and not white to clog pores or causes whiteheads.
The cleanser has a smooth and easy to spread texture, and the scent is light but very pleasant. It's easy and quick to use and I like the natural ingredients to safely and effectively wash my skin.

I recently tried this cleanser and was blown away by how gentle yet effective it was. The oat extract in the formula helps to calm and soothe sensitive skin, while also removing dirt and oil without stripping away your skin's natural moisture. And the best part? It's fragrance-free, hypoallergenic, and non-comedogenic, so it's safe for all skin types! Plus, it's formulated with prebiotic oat to help strengthen your skin's moisture barrier and protect against environmental stressors. I've been using this cleanser daily and my skin has never felt so soft and nourished. So if you're in the market for a new cleanser, give Aveeno Face Calm + Restore Nourishing Oat Cleanser a try - your skin will thank you.

To say this face cleanser is amazing is an understatement. Speaking from a dry skin perspective, I couldn't be happier to have found this product. It's gentle, moisturizing, refreshing, and NOT STICKY AT ALL. I've been using it at night and yes, you definitely notice a difference in the morning. It easily removes makeup (maybe with mascara you have to do a second pass), but I definitely love this product, I wouldn't change a thing about it.
I like the gentle ingredients and that it's not perfumed. It's great for sensitive skin without sacrificing cleansing ability which is the case too often with sensitive skin washes.

I have very sensitive skin and have tried a few different products. I have never had my face feel as moisturized than after using this product. My face felt soft and refreshed after using this product. There are no odors to it and it doesn't make you feel like a flower after using it. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin.
I feel good using this on my skin. It feels soothing and doesn't cause any breakouts or rashes.

I've been using this cleanser for a couple of weeks now and it's made my skin feel super soft. It was gentle but got the job done and didn't strip my skin. I would recommend this to anyone with dry or sensitive skin.
The Aveeno calm + restore nourishing oat cleanser is perfect for sensitive skin. It goes on easy and feels smooth and soothing. A little goes a long way. It left my face feeling clean and refreshed.

I loved this oatmeal facial cleanser, it is very gentle, it dissolves very well on the skin, removing impurities and can even remove makeup, it is not heavy, it has a very soft texture, it is free of fragrances, colorants, alcohol and parabens, making it ideal for sensitive and dry skin. Although my skin is oily, when I use it, it leaves it very soft, hydrated with a healthy appearance and without fat. I love the packaging it comes in, as it is an easy-to-dispense dispenser.
This is a very soothing cleanser. It leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and moisturized. It bery happy with it and I will repurchase

Aveeno Calm + Restore Cleanser does a great job at cleansing my face. It's soothing and gentle. My skin feels nourished and clean after use. There's no feeling of dryness or tightness. I love how it's fragrance-free too.

The Aveeno Calm + Restore nourishing oat cleanser has been so good for my skin. It makes my skin feel hydrated and so smooth. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for a great hydrating cleanser.

I have been using Aveeno Calm + Restore Gentle Nourishing Oat Face Cleanser for almost 2 weeks and I have to admit this product feels so genuine. I use it twice a day and every time it feels so fresh and my skin feels so soft and clean. Although my skin is not very sensitive, it's quite dry and never had a good experience post face wash unless I apply moisturizer. My face feels just awesome after using this and wont tighten up. Feels very pleasant while using this.

The Aveeno Calm + Restore Gentle Nourishing Oat Face Cleanser is a great everyday face wash for anyone who has dry or sensitive skin and is looking for a gentle cleanser. It gives a soothing and hydrating cleansing experience. The cleanser is light weight with a creamy consistency that lathers well but also doesn't strip the skin. It leaves my face feeling clean but not tight or dry. I use this face cleanser morning and night and I think it would be great for someone with compromised skin barriers. It is formulated with nourishing oat and calming ingredients. This cleanser will leave your skin feeling soft and nourished.
